---
title: Scrambled eggs with anchovies and truffle
id: MAR-0080
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 23
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 8 eggs
- 40 g truffle
- 5 anchovy fillets in oil
- 2 tablespoons fresh cream
- 30 g butter
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the cream, season with salt, and beat with a fork.
2. Heat the butter in a nonstick skillet, add the anchovies and let them melt, stirring with a wooden spoon.
3. Turn up the heat, pour the eggs over them and let them set, always stirring with a wooden spoon.
4. Pour the eggs onto a serving plate and finish with a grind of pepper and truffle shavings.
